transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. It's nice to meet you too. 

I came in today because... well, my mind just will not hold onto things anymore. I'll sit down to write a simple note for the youth maker program, which is something I could do in my sleep before, and... the numbers and words just scatter on me. I just can't seem to put my thoughts together.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people do not?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I'm not seeing or hearing anything unusual, it's just... the trouble with my thoughts and memory.
Have you been feeling depressed?

Yes, I have. Most days, I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling right in my chest. It's just... it's always there. Even when my wife is right there talking kindly to me, I just feel like I'm sitting at the bottom of a well.
Have you been feeling that you have done something terribly wrong or caused harm, even when others tell you that you have not?
No, I haven't had any thoughts like that. I don't feel like I've done anything terribly wrong or hurt anybody.
Do you ever lose track of what day or date it is?
No, I don't really lose track of the days. I mean, sometimes I have to think about it for a second since I'm retired and not on a strict schedule anymore, but... no, I always know what the date is.
Have you lost interest in the things you usually enjoy?

Yes. I just... I don't care about any of it anymore. I haven't touched the wood pieces sitting on my workbench in weeks. I skipped the choir planning committee, and my regular chess games. Even fishing... I don't know, it just sounds like more effort than it's worth. And that's really not like me at all.
Have you had thoughts that life is not worth living?

Yes, I have. Lately, I keep thinking that my family might just be better off without me around. It's... well, it's gotten to the point where if I'm near my workshop, I actually get a bit scared of where my thoughts might go if I'm left alone in there for too long.
Have you been having trouble finding the right words when you speak or write?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I mean, I'm probably not talking as much as I used to lately, just keeping to myself more... but when I do speak, I don't have any trouble finding the words.
If someone gives you a hint or reminds you, does that usually help you remember the thing you were trying to recall?
No, I haven't really noticed any issues with my memory like that. I don't feel like I need hints to remember things. I just... I haven't had any trouble recalling things when I need to.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably more slowly than usual?

Yes, I have. Everything I do just feels... slowed down. It's like it takes extra effort just to get up out of my chair. Even when I'm trying to answer a question, it feels like my body and my tongue are just... moving through wet cement. It just takes me longer to do or say anything right now.
Have these thinking problems made you need help with everyday tasks you used to manage on your own, like paying bills, taking medications, or handling appointments?

Yes, they really have. I've just... I've let a lot of things fall away lately. My church responsibilities, taking care of the garden, the youth maker program... I just can't manage them. My wife and our pastor have actually had to step in to help handle things for me. I don't even feel safe being out in my workshop by myself anymore, so... yes, I've definitely needed them to take over what I used to do on my own.
